WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
    AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_rebate_fee_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    avg_total_rebate,
    avg_rebate_fee_ratio,
    AVG(avg_rebate_fee_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM per_order
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  avg_total_rebate,
  avg_rebate_fee_ratio,
  avg_rebate_fee_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM with_mean
WHERE overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Orders are grouped by the fee table's orderslink; null links, if present, form a single group. Division by a zero fee rate is treated as missing, and AVG ignores missing values.
